userStories.title: Add /api/health endpoint
userStories.description: REST API to query connection health and packet stats
userStories.diff:
@app.route('/api/health')
def get_health():
+ current_time = time.time()
+ seconds_since_last = None
+ if packet_stats['last_packet_time']:
+   seconds_since_last = current_time - packet_stats['last_packet_time']
+
+ status = 'green'
+ if seconds_since_last is None or seconds_since_last > 5:
+   status = 'red'
+ elif seconds_since_last > 1:
+   status = 'yellow'
+
+ return jsonify({
+   'status': status,
+   'total_packets': packet_stats['total_packets'],
+   'dropped_packets': packet_stats['dropped_packets'],
+   'seconds_since_last': seconds_since_last,
+   'last_packet_time': packet_stats['last_packet_time']
+ })
acceptanceCriteria: Status logic matches frontend (green <1s, yellow 1-5s, red >5s)
verification_steps: Verify JSON response with all fields
